name: Lever
description: Lever is an applicant tracking system (ATS) with built-in candidate relationship management (CRM), owned by Employ Inc., used by talent acquisition teams to source, screen, and manage candidates through hiring with AI-assisted screening and analytics.
best_for: Talent acquisition teams at small, mid-sized, and enterprise organizations that want an ATS combined with CRM-style candidate nurturing rather than a bare-bones tracking tool.
features: Combined ATS and CRM in one system for tracking applicants and nurturing passive candidate pipelines
AI screening that qualifies and ranks candidates by fit and surfaces summaries
Interview Intelligence: AI-generated interview transcripts and summaries
Fraud detection with identity verification and resume conflict/risk assessment
Candidate nurture campaigns with customizable email templates and multi-touch sequences
Analytics and reporting dashboards for hiring metrics, AI ROI, and feature adoption
AI Governance: built-in bias screening, compliance checks, and audit trails for AI-generated content such as rejection emails
Centralized pipeline visibility across candidates, requisitions, and job sites
Automated scheduling, follow-ups, and offer letter generation
pros: Pairs ATS functionality with native CRM-style candidate nurturing rather than requiring a separate sourcing tool
Publishes explicit SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001, GDPR, and CCPA compliance information on its security page
Includes AI governance features (bias screening, audit trails) specifically for AI-generated hiring content
cons: No pricing is published; every quote requires contacting sales and is tailored to organization size and hiring needs
Web-only platform with no dedicated mobile app mentioned on the site

alternatives.name: Greenhouse
alternatives.description: A dedicated applicant tracking and hiring platform focused on structured, data-driven recruiting.
alternatives.best_for: Companies wanting structured interview kits and hiring analytics as the primary focus rather than combined ATS/CRM nurture campaigns.

alternatives.name: BambooHR
alternatives.description: An HRIS for small and mid-sized businesses with an applicant tracking system bundled into the core HR platform.
alternatives.best_for: Smaller businesses that want hiring bundled into a broader HR system of record rather than a dedicated best-in-class ATS.
